integrity.classification_basis: A symbolic adjacent-n ratio makes degree/Euler strictly increasing for fixed k>=2, and a symbolic Lagrangian boundary recurrence settles all k>=3.
integrity.degree_basis: The Plücker degree is derived in the result from Borel--Weil and the type-C Weyl dimension formula, then simplified to the stated factorial product.
integrity.euler_basis: The Bruhat-cell count is the order of the type-C Weyl quotient and equals 2^k binomial(n,k).
integrity.first_public_date_basis: The arXiv record for 0811.2781 lists version 1 on 2008-11-17.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The same arXiv record lists primary MSC 14N15.

scientific_limitations: The degree is for the standard Plücker polarization.
The theorem treats complex symplectic Grassmannians of type C only.
The comparison is numerical and does not provide a direct geometric bijection between linear-section points and Schubert cells.
The input formulas are classical or follow from standard representation theory, so an older unindexed source may contain the same inequality.
title: A sharp degree–Euler dichotomy for symplectic Grassmannians
